summary: Iteration 41 testing - Multi-select Trip Types, Tab Navigation, Hideable Sections. ALL FEATURES WORKING. Backend: 9/9 tests PASS (100%). Frontend: ALL tests PASS. The NEW multi-select trip types feature allows selecting 2+ types (toggle on/off), 'Passeio' replaced 'Relaxamento', counter shows 'X tipos selecionados'. Unified document card with tab navigation (Guia/Roteiro/Checklist/Dicas), Guia tab active by default with orange color. Hideable sections with 'Ocultar esta secção' toggle persist to localStorage. Footer has Ajustar plano/Copiar/Partilhar buttons. Booking section inside Guia tab. Sticky bar appears on scroll. Mobile 375px renders tabs without overflow.
